column1: # models.transform.catalog.tsv - the text transformer models the Text Transform chooser offers,
# best -> smallest WITHIN each family. Same columns and rules as models.catalog.tsv:
# Every row here is a gguf row (transformers run on the bundled llama-server). The install name
# (column 3) is the directory under Transformers/ and the key the app uses to find a model's
# family - presets (Resources/Transformers/*.json) name a family, and the window offers the
# installed variants of that family. The gguf file may sit in a repo subfolder; the download
# worker moves it to the top of the install directory.
